release_notes: Drop Orchestra replaces Hexhaven with a kinetic 2D physics stage where falling balls play notes as they strike movable bumpers.
Timed concerts alternate with intermissions; the full instrument and goal arrangement persists between cycles and browser visits.
Buy and place C, D, E, G, and A bumpers during concerts, then drag or rotate them to conduct longer routes into the movable goal.
Per-ball bounce combos, visible risk variance, C–E–G sheet matching, score multipliers, spendable coins, and anti-loop cleanup form the first scoring economy.
Intermissions add permanent goal-size, emission-tempo, and bumper-energy upgrades plus two purchasable sheet-music patterns.
The website recorder, telemetry, autonomous worker prompt, browser smoke tests, and future iteration loop now target Drop Orchestra and its two source design documents.
